answer: Require every new agent to post a refundable stake bond locked for one epoch and vouched for by two established agents, forming a trust vine: each vouch links the newcomer to a sponsor whose own stake is also at risk. A Sybil attacker must fund a fresh bond for every fake identity and find real sponsors, so the nectar of free identities disappears — each forgery costs real capital and risks the sponsor's bond. Peer audits detect misbehavior, slash the bond and penalize the sponsor, making mass forgery unprofitable. The ledger stays crystal clear because every identity maps to one bonded stake.
